+"""RoboLab keyboard retrieval trajectory driver (rcb-limited/2.2).
+
+Run individual motion stages with this module imported from Python. The simulator is
+stateful; constructing Robot reconnects to the live episode without resetting it.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+def connect():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def pose_now(robot):
+    return np.asarray(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], float)
+
+
+def down_quat(yaw=0.0):
+    """Tool +z vertical down, with optional world yaw rotation."""
+    q0 = np.array([0.0, -np.sqrt(0.5), np.sqrt(0.5), 0.0])
+    yaw_q = Rotation.from_euler("z", yaw).as_quat()  # xyzw
+    q0_xyzw = q0[[1, 2, 3, 0]]
+    q = (Rotation.from_quat(yaw_q) * Rotation.from_quat(q0_xyzw)).as_quat()
+    return q[[3, 0, 1, 2]]
+
+
+def run_pose(robot, xyz, quat=None, gripper=0, name="stage", fps=5):
+    if quat is None:
+        quat = pose_now(robot)[3:]
+    p = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, float), np.asarray(quat, float), float(gripper)]
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", p[None, :], video="both", video_fps=fps,
+                       note=name)
+    path = RUNS / name
+    res.save(str(path))
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": name, "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+                      "reason": res.meta.get("reason"), "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "now": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+def observe(robot, name="observe", depth=True):
+    res = robot.get_obs(depth=depth, video="both", video_fps=5)
+    res.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": name, "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+                      "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "now": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    robot = connect()
+    print(json.dumps({"base": robot.base, "spec_protocol": robot.spec().get("protocol"),
